comparison.objective: Read a port-map and insert three patch cords into specified ports, not commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable handling and keyed connector insertion; no hex-key-driven unlocking, collar rotation, torque-controlled locking, or impact assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Each color reaches its mapped numbered port, all other ports remain empty, and plugs are released; insertion depth tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests symbolic mapping plus connector insertion, a different mechanism and outcome.
